value.rationale: PASS. Backward Euler is a standard practical startup for BDF2, and classical positivity theory emphasizes that multistep positivity depends on the starting procedure. The finding identifies the exact first post-start positivity mechanism for the canonical Dirichlet heat matrix, collapses a full matrix sign test to one boundary scalar, supplies a sharp semi-infinite constant, and gives a minimal small-grid rational witness. This is a structural boundary effect rather than a routine recomputation of a known table. Risk: its scope is narrow and does not by itself yield an all-time maximum principle.
